name: ESP32-C3 (BLE beacon)

firmware.note: CircuitPython on the board, fox-bench's foxlib and a BLE template (BLE beacon, puzzle beacon) deployed over the REPL as precompiled .mpy (the sources do not fit: MemoryError compiling netcfg.py). The SoC's own radio: no module. On the bench 2026-11-23 (docs/hardware-log.md); Wi-Fi templates are not offered on this target — see radios_note.

radios_note: The chip has Wi-Fi too, and a Wi-Fi fox boots on it from the precompiled set with ~36 KB of heap left — then CircuitPython's core hard-faults while the access point runs (XIAO ESP32C3, CircuitPython 10.3.2, 2026-11-23: safe mode, 'hard fault: memory access or instruction error'). Below what foxlib can do anything about, so this target offers BLE only; the BLE beacon and puzzle beacon hold their wakes with 27–31 KB free. For Wi-Fi foxes use the C6 or the S3; the same board with an SA868 is the FM fox (seeed_xiao_esp32c3).
